WITH college_player_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.college_id,
        c.state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) as distinct_players
    FROM player_college pc
    JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
),
global_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(distinct_players) as global_avg_players,
        SUM(distinct_players) as total_players
    FROM college_player_counts
),
college_with_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cpc.state,
        cpc.distinct_players,
        cpc.distinct_players / gs.global_avg_players as ratio_to_global_avg,
        cpc.distinct_players / gs.total_players as share_of_total
    FROM college_player_counts cpc
    CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
)
SELECT 
    state,
    AVG(distinct_players) as avg_colleges_count,
    AVG(ratio_to_global_avg) as avg_ratio,
    AVG(share_of_total) as avg_share
FROM college_with_metrics
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state
